'''Edmo Ectacle''' was a [[Moldwarp]] [[Gender|male]] with [[Color|gray]] [[hair]] and brown skin. In [[34 ABY]], Ectacle was in the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] in the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] and watched other patrons play at the [[Gambling|game]] tables before speaking with [[Derla Pidys]] on one of the [[casino]]'s balconies. Ectacle later hid in [[Black Spire Outpost]] on the [[planet]] [[Batuu]] while there was an oustanding [[bounty]] on him. At around this [[time]], the [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] used Ectacle's [[Thief|stolen]] identity profile to test potential employees of [[Ohnaka Transport Solutions]].

==Biography==
Edmo Ectacle was a [[Moldwarp]] [[Gender|male]] who was [[Reproduction|born]] on<ref name="Datapad" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Traveler's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge: Traveler's Guide to Batuu]]''</ref> [[Lespectus]]<ref name="Datapad" /> around [[22 BBY]].<ref name="GEDates" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VIII}} to [[34 ABY]].</ref> he<ref name="Twitter" /> was present in the [[Canto Casino and Racetrack|Canto Casino]] within the [[city]] of [[Canto Bight]] on the planet [[Cantonica]].<ref name="TLJVD" /> While in the [[casino]], Ectacle spent [[time]] at the [[Gambling|game]] tables and watched<ref name="TLJ">{{Film|VIII}}</ref> the [[Suerton]] [[Thodibin]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> playing at one. The Moldwarp then moved out onto one of the casino's balconies, which overlooked a [[fathier]] race taking place on the Canto Bight [[racetrack]]. While on the balcony, Ectacle spoke with<ref name="TLJ" /> the [[liquor]] [[Merchant|trader]] [[Derla Pidys]]<ref name="TLJVD" /> while the [[Resistance]] agents [[Finn]] and [[Rose Tico]] watched the race nearby.<ref name="TLJ" />

During the [[First Order]] [[Battle of Batuu|occupation]] of the planet [[Batuu]]<ref name="Datapad" /> in 34 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]],<ref name="GEDates" /> there was an outstanding [[bounty]] of 875 [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] on Ectacle for [[gambling]] debts, racketeering, and theft of a [[gold]]-plated [[Twi'lek Ark|ark]] from the local [[antiques dealer]] [[Dok-Ondar]]. Ectacle was hiding in one of the buildings of [[Black Spire Outpost]] on Batuu when the bounty was assigned to an individual visiting the outpost by the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. The visitor then used a [[thermal scanner]] to uncover Ectacle's location, which they reported to the local [[Guildmaster's Hideout]] in order to collect the bounty.<ref name="Bounty Hunters">{{DatapadCite|''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]''|BatuuBountyHunters-EdmoEctaclee.png}}</ref> During this [[time]] frame, the [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]] had obtained a [[Thief|stolen]] identity profile of Ectacle, who was fifty-six [[Standard year|years]] old at the time. Ohnaka sent the profile, along with several others, to the [[datapad]] of individuals interested in joining a potential flight crew that he was putting together for a [[Heist on a First Order train|job]] with [[Ohnaka Transport Solutions]]. The pirate had the individuals memorize details from the profile and then quizzed them on the information.<ref name="Datapad" />

==Personality and traits==
Edmo Ectacle had black [[eye]]s, [[Color|gray]] [[hair]],<ref name="Datapad" /> and brown skin.<ref name="TLJVD" /> He stood six [[Foot|feet]] tall and weighed 180 [[pound]]s.<ref name="Datapad" />

==Equipment==
Ectacle wore a black [[Clothing|jacket]], [[robe]]s, and [[belt]] over a white shirt. He used a medicated [[aerosol inhaler]] and wore white [[goggles]].<ref name="TLJVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Cantina_Aliens_37A.png|thumb|right|250px|"Cantina Aliens 37A"]]
Edmo Ectacle first appeared in the [[2017]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']],<ref name="TLJ" /> and he was first named in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Last Jedi: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released alongside the film.<ref name="TLJVD" /> The character was portrayed by creature and [[droid]] performer [[Tom Wilton]], who described the costume as easy to see out of and breathe in. Finishing touches were added to the costume by [[Kati Hood]],<ref name="Twitter" /> and concept art of Ectacle, titled "Cantina Aliens 37A," was produced by creature concept designer [[Jake Lunt Davies]] for the film.<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref>

In the film's deleted scenes, Ectacle can be seen cheering at one of the gaming tables.<ref name="TLJ" /> Wilton has said that director of photography [[Steve Yedlin]] selected Ectacle out of a lineup to appear in another shot that ultimately did not make it into the film. In that shot, Ectacle climbs out from under a table after Canto Casino was wrecked by escaped fathiers. He then walks to the center of the room and surveys the damage before shaking his head.<ref name="Twitter 2">{{Twitter|tomKwilton|status/1085832542098522113|[[Tom Wilton]]|quote=2/2 Steve Yedlin picked Edmo out of a line up for a great shot that didn't make the final edit. After the fathiers have trashed the casino Edmo climbs out from under a table and walks into the centre of the room, stares around at the destruction and shakes his head. #StarWars|archiveurl=https://archive.is/l3Wrd}}</ref>

Edmo Ectacle's surname is misspelt as "Ectaclee" in ''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]'', an augmented reality [[Star Wars video games|video game]] launched at [[Wikipedia:Walt Disney World|Walt Disney World]]<ref name="Bounty Hunters" /> on [[July 27]], [[2022]].<ref name="DPB Launching">{{DPB|url=2022/07/magicbandplus-launching-july-27-at-walt-disney-world|text=MagicBand+ Launching July 27 at Walt Disney World|nolive=1}}</ref>
